entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Hm... Not great, but I think you're on[n]the right track.
entries.uk: Гм... Не блискуче, але, гадаю,[n]ти на правильному шляху.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: That was actually pretty fun, Inmate.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Allow me to disclose the results of our[n]examination.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: If I had to describe your current state...

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: I would say you are: One With Potential.
entries.uk: Я сказала б, що ти —[n]Той, хто має потенціал.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: You're really shooting for the stars, huh?

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Don't let it get to your head. You've still[n]got a long way to go.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: However, you did put up a fair fight.[n]Accept this.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Continue training and come back later.[n]Perhaps next time we will have a more[n]enticing match.
